cues: Do not mix up the two orders.
For S N one, tertiary is fastest, because three alkyl groups stabilise the carbocation.
For S N two it is exactly reversed, because three bulky groups block the backside attack.
Only the leaving group order is the same for both.
text: Do not mix up the two orders. For S N one, tertiary is fastest, because three alkyl groups stabilise the carbocation. For S N two it is exactly reversed, because three bulky groups block the backside attack. That is steric hindrance. Only the leaving group order is the same for both.
